title: claude-mem: memory for your coding agent, across sessions

facts.license: Apache-2.0 (internal field only; not spoken or shown)
facts.description: Captures what your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode and more.
facts.method: installs as a plugin for the agent; records sessions, compresses them into notes, and loads the relevant notes at the start of the next session
facts.requirements: Node 20 or newer (README badge); worker runs locally
facts.limits: capture depends on the agent integration installed; recall is not automatic for every tool (maker FAQ); not verified: exact install steps
facts.media_plan: tool's own README animation (cm-preview) as clip scenes; maker logo on a card; no maker video exists

verify_before_render: Capture pack repo-claude-mem-01 is built from the maker's README animation and logo only. No filming.

scenes.heading: YOUR AGENT FORGETS?
scenes.say: Does your coding agent forget everything the moment you close the session?

scenes.heading: CLAUDE-MEM
scenes.say: Claude-mem is open-source coding agent memory: it records what your agent did in each session and keeps the useful parts.

scenes.heading: IT KEEPS THE DECISIONS
scenes.say: As the agent works, it saves the decisions, the discoveries and the fixes, then compresses them into short notes.

scenes.heading: NEXT SESSION
scenes.say: When you start a new session, the relevant notes load back in, so the agent can pick up where it stopped.

scenes.heading: WORKS ACROSS TOOLS
scenes.sub: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and more
scenes.say: It works with several coding agents, but capture depends on the integration you install, so check your setup first.
